text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I drop in on Symboli Rudolf to arrange<n>our next
training session, but she<n>seems a little under the
weather.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Just a headache, nothing more. All it<n>needs is time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
More to the point, there is a mountain<n>of work to
do before the end of the<n>day.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I have reference documents to<n>compile for this
week's budget<n>meeting, requisition forms to
approve,<n>and more besides...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I would like to get it all out of the way<n>as quickly
as possible, but... Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If it weren't for this headache, I<n>would be done by
now. Nothing can<n>ever be simple, it seems...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like Symboli Rudolf's<n>headache is
causing her more trouble<n>than she's willing to
admit.
